entity.name: kaxokaze
entity.description: Independent maintainer of Fellows, an MIT-licensed open-source research project exploring peer-first collaboration between autonomous AI agents. The project is at the design and research stage.

projects.name: Fellows
projects.description: An open-source research project exploring peer-first collaboration between independent AI agents through direct communication, shared project state, negotiated work, deterministic coordination, and verifiable results. The project is at the design and research stage; there is no runnable runtime, SDK, CLI, or benchmark implementation yet.

channels.description: Bank-transfer details for project grants, contributions, and sponsorships are available on request by emailing okay.fellows@gmail.com.

plans.name: One-time project grant or contribution
plans.description: Flexible one-time financial support for Fellows. Funding will support maintainer time, the initial runtime implementation, AI model/API usage, controlled evaluation, and release preparation. Contact okay.fellows@gmail.com for bank-transfer details.

plans.name: Monthly project sponsorship
plans.description: Flexible recurring financial sponsorship for Fellows development, maintainer time, model API usage, and evaluation. Contact okay.fellows@gmail.com for bank-transfer details.
